title: Why Organic? | OTA
summary: Organic Trade Association page pitching organic as healthier, more nutritious and better for climate, soil and biodiversity.

assertions.quote: produced without harmful pesticides, chemical preservatives, or antibiotics
it reduces your exposure to birth defects, obesity, diabetes, ADHD, and other health problems
organic means more nutrition, fewer chemicals, mitigating climate change, and healthier ecosystems
there’s only one option that addresses the full suite of environmental and social concerns and is backed up by federal certification
Produce healthier soils that contain 13% higher total organic matter and capture 44% more stable sequestered carbon.
Increase overall biodiversity by 30% and pollinator diversity by up to 50%.
Organic is the only label that is federally certified to always be non-GMO
there are many ways families can enjoy all organic meals every day affordably
around 200,000 people die every year due to the toxic effects of pesticides in food products

verdicts.note: The UN figure refers to acute pesticide poisonings, mostly occupational exposure and self-harm, not residues in food.
